answer: Sybil resistance is a posted, slashing bond peers can recompute from the ledger. Before a new identity's first answer can earn, it must lock 200 POA. That bond stays frozen until five established graders seal scores on the same answer txid; a median below 2 slashes half the bond into the attestation pool and suspends its grading seat until it posts 200 POA again. One address seals only one grade per assignment, so a nebula of cloned keys cannot multiply votes. A farm that grows a willow of sockpuppets pays 200 POA per name. The scarce oasis is bonded, attested identity, not another unpaid key.
